title: Baker Mayfield "ready to go," Emeka Egbuka is doubtful to play for Bucs

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Baker Mayfield "ready to go," Emeka Egbuka is doubtful to play for Bucs
sources.description: Baker Mayfield is set to return to the Buccaneers lineup for Sunday's game against the Panthers, but it looks like the quarterback will be missing one of his top targets.
